extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Computer system overview — a computer system has hardware (physical parts you can touch) and software (programs/instructions). They work together. (2) Main components — CPU (Central Processing Unit, the brain, processes data), Memory (RAM - temporary, ROM - permanent), Input devices (keyboard, mouse, scanner - send data to computer), Output devices (monitor, printer, speaker - show results), Storage (hard drive, USB drive, CD - store data permanently). (3) Types of software — System software (operating systems like Windows, Linux, Android - manage hardware), Application software (MS Word, Paint, games, browsers - do specific tasks for users). (4) GUI operating system — Windows desktop (main screen), icons (small pictures for programs), taskbar (bottom bar, shows open programs and time), Start menu (click Start to see all programs), GUI means Graphical User Interface (use mouse and pictures, not text commands). (5) Windows operations — minimize (hide window to taskbar), maximize (make window fill screen), restore (return to smaller size), close (exit program, red X button). Misconceptions: 'CPU and monitor are the same' (CPU is the brain inside the box, monitor is just the screen), 'software is something you can touch' (software is programs/instructions, hardware is physical), 'Windows is an application' (Windows is an operating system = system software, not application), 'minimize closes the program' (minimize hides the window but keeps the program running in taskbar), 'RAM and hard drive are the same' (RAM is temporary memory that clears when power is off, hard drive is permanent storage). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ComputerSystemGame), NOT export default. Export interface ComputerSystemGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
